name: How can a duplex increase property value and rental income?

mainEntity.name: How can a duplex increase property value and rental income?

acceptedAnswer.text: A well-designed and constructed duplex can significantly enhance property value and generate substantial rental income. The presence of two independent units on a single lot offers increased density, which is often attractive in high-demand areas. The ability to rent out one unit provides a consistent revenue stream, which can cover mortgage payments or act as a standalone investment. Furthermore, high-quality, luxury duplexes built by Opus Builders are perceived as premium assets, appealing to both renters and future buyers, thus boosting overall market value.
acceptedAnswer.description: A duplex increases property value by offering two units on one lot and generates rental income from one or both units, providing a strong return on investment.
